title: 435. Line Reflection

examples.explanation: The line x = 0 reflects each point onto the other.
The mirror of (1,1) across any vertical line through these x values would be (-1,1), which is absent.

hints: If a mirror exists, it must sit halfway between the smallest and largest x values.
Store all points in a hash set, then check the mirror partner of each point.
Use the sum minX + maxX to avoid fractions: the partner of x is (minX + maxX - x).
